evidenceFields.datumControl: Vertical NAVD88 as reported by the 3DEP source (not re-projected, not certified); tile grid Web Mercator EPSG:3857. EPSG:2966 is a horizontal CRS and is NOT claimed for this product.
evidenceFields.sourceDataset: USGS 3DEP-derived Terrarium tiles (AWS elevation-tiles-prod), z13, 192x192 screening grid, 62.5 ft cells, elevations 337.7-372.5 ft

terrainPipeline.processingToolchain: 3DEP Terrarium tiles -> tools/terrain/fetch-terrarium-dem.py (screening DEM + SHA-256 manifest) -> scripts/geospatial/build-terrain-rgb.sh (pure-Python Mapbox Terrain-RGB encoder; GDAL/rio-rgbify unavailable on build host, byte-identical encoding, round-trip verified) -> XYZ PNG pyramid -> scripts/geospatial/pack-terrain-mbtiles.py (terrain-3dep.mbtiles) -> Martin v0.17.1 + Caddy (TLS) on tile host; Express+TLS server for local dev
